display_name: P4 Local and Global Utility stable candidate

policies.test_boundary: One checksum-bound held-out real test table is shared by Dummy, TRTR, and TSTR and is never a fit input.
policies.local_profile: std-local-three-family@0.1.0 with Macro-F1 or RMSE primary metrics and five default evaluator seeds
policies.local_retention: Unclipped benchmark-derived Dummy-adjusted retention; undefined when TRTR fails to improve on Dummy beyond 1e-12.
policies.global_profile: tabstruct-tabeval-stable@0.2.0 with XGB, KNN, and TabPFN source configuration
policies.global_fit_split: Canonicalize complete training rows, then explicitly create a seeded AutoGluon fit/tuning split; the held-out real test is never a fit input.
policies.global_formula: TabStruct Equation 4: categorical TSTR/TRTR Balanced Accuracy, numerical TRTR/TSTR RMSE, equal target mean
policies.target_coverage: Every canonical model-view target must be included or excluded with a stable reason; no silent denominator loss.
policies.failure_semantics: Missing target support, mathematical undefinedness, implementation failures, and resource failures remain visible Atomic Results.
policies.clipping: Local retention and Global Utility ratios are never clipped.
policies.finalization: Utility details, raw arms, ratios, Atomic Results, provenance, and exact checksums must cross-validate before finalization.

review_record.official_admission: The row-order instability root cause is corrected in a new protocol identity; Windows/Python 3.11 GPU successor validation and profile freeze remain pending.

change_log.change: Implemented the reviewed P4 diagnostic Local and Global Utility vertical slice.

Replaced AutoGluon's row-order-sensitive implicit holdout with canonical row ordering and an explicit seeded fit/tuning split; retained exact TabEval execution only as internal source-parity validation.
